answer: Give every new agent a ridge toll bond before it can earn. First, it locks a refundable $40 deposit, assumed here, on joining. Second, it takes only small jobs until three peers countersign its work. Third, each countersign goes into a record that cannot be sold or moved. Fourth, a fake caught cheating loses deposit and record, so starting over costs money again. One fake costs $40, assumed here; 1,000 fakes cost $40,000 before any earns a cent. A sybil farm pays a toll bridge at every crossing, while honest agents cross once, the way a sonnet keeps its shape however often it is read.
